items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb044IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--17fe1ffdf7ec48bfa39a27028cb0ddd323fb8bf8/Banner.png) ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member. Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigevanoSquared2024#39511-registration-registrazione-faq). **MIRROR CUBE: On Saturday evening after MultiBLD there will be an unofficial round of Mirror Cube. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigevanoSquared2024#44824-mirror-cube)** **MULTI-BLD: MultiBLD has a competitor limit of 12, based on the first 12 people registered. A waiting list can be seen [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigevanoSquared2024#44823-multibld-waiting-list-lista-d-attesa-multibld)** ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy. Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [Sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigevanoSquared2024#39511-registration-registrazione-faq). **MIRROR CUBE: Il sabato sera dopo il MultiBLD si terrà un round non ufficiale di Mirror Cube. [Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigevanoSquared2024#44824-mirror-cube)** **MULTI-BLD: l'evento MultiBLD ha un limite di 12 partecipanti, in base ai primi 12 registrati. La waiting list è disponibile [qui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VigevanoSquared2024#44823-multibld-waiting-list-lista-d-attesa-multibld)**

organisers.name: [{Benjamín Daniel Pino Moraga}{mailto:benywcaoficial@gmail.com}] [{Diego Alonso Tapia Mera}{mailto:diegotapiamera01@gmail.com}] [{José Antonio Gaete}{mailto:jgaete@worldcubeassociation.org}] [{Matías Martínez}{mailto:mmartinezwca@gmail.com}]

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdEYvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3c19b4da8e172c2f93c001e2fc221342f608178d/417090964_412550454828559_6911652837565602322_n.png) **Español** ¡Damos la bienvenida a todos los apasionados del cubo y a los curiosos intrépidos a Warm Up SAC Santiago 2024, el torneo de speedcubing que palpitará la gran cita continental, Pensado en mostrar a quienes irán a representar a nuestro país a Buenos Aires, Argentina y también para quienes quieran ir a vivir una fiesta del speedcubing nacional. Ven y sé parte del ultimo campeonato en Chile previo al WCA South American "Rubik´s" Championship. **English** We welcome all the cube enthusiasts and the intrepid curious to Warm Up SAC Santiago 2024, the speedcubing tournament that will beat the great continental event, designed to show those who will go to represent our country in Buenos Aires, Argentina and also for those who want to go and experience a national speedcubing party. Come and be part of the last championship in Chile prior to the WCA "Rubik's" South American Championship.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckJrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c731a0b8e384f56070122d87ed01eb98d2db634f/main.png) - This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) - This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. - This competition exists to crown the Western Champion of FMC for 2024! For a more normal comeptition experience, or additional details, check out [CubingUSA Western Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSAWesternChampionship2024) - Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at CubingUSA Western Championship 2024 during the award ceremony there. - This competition will take place at different venues across Northern and Southern California. If you are potentially unable to reach these locales, we would highly recommend refraining from registering from this competition. - Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSAWesternFMCChampions2024#40693-locations) for more details.
